services.name: 33ft Boat Deep Sea Charter - Half Day - $950
services.desc: Central Florida is one of the best places in the world to enjoy a nearshore or deep sea fishing charter. Several miles off of Port Canaveral lies Ship Wrecks and Reefs to fish over. Weather permitting, our comfortable boats arrive at the fishing location and set you up to battle different types of species! Travel time to the reefs or wrecks can be anywhere from 75-90 minutes. Our main goal is to catch fish and have a good time, any fish we catch that we can legally keep will be fillet for you at the end of the trip! $950 total price for 1-6 people! services.name: Sea Burial/Ash Scattering $600
services.desc: Honor your loved one with a peaceful and private sea burial or ash scattering service aboard Fin & Fly Charters. Departing from Cocoa Beach, our compassionate memorial charters provide families with a meaningful way to celebrate a life well lived on the beautiful Atlantic Ocean. Each ceremony is conducted in accordance with federal regulations and can be personalized with prayers, readings, music, or quiet reflection. Our experienced captain provides a respectful, private setting, allowing family and friends the time and space to say goodbye in a serene ocean
